key_concepts: Sound travels as a wave and needs a medium
Sound travels fastest in solids and slowest in gases
Speed of sound in air increases with temperature
Speed of sound in air is 331 m/s at 0°C and changes by 0.6 m/s per °C
Visible light is the part of electromagnetic radiation visible to the human eye
Red has the longest wavelength and lowest energy; violet has the shortest wavelength and h
Refraction bends light when it passes from one medium to another while frequency remains c
White light can be dispersed into colors by water or a prism
The sky appears blue because atmospheric molecules scatter blue light more
Heat is energy transferred from hot to cold; temperature is average kinetic energy of mole
Specific heat capacity is the energy needed to change 1 kg of a substance by 1°C
Heat transferred or absorbed can be calculated using Q = mcΔT
